tiktok.body:
Three of my favorite side hustle apps that a beginner can start on today. No social media or experience needed! #sidehustle #makemoneyonline #makemoneyfromhome #sahmsidehustle #sidehustleideas
Three free side hustle apps that you can start making money on today with zero social media and no buy in. Hi, my name is Tara. I share a whole bunch of different side hustles and the free, honest advice of if they actually work here on my channel. And the three apps that I recommend over and over and over that I think are awesome are presto shopper, secret shopper, and D Scout. Now, what are these? These are a mix of a focus group, studies and mystery shops. What's a mystery shop? A mystery shop is where brands pay you to come to their business, do it to specific type of shop, and then you get paid a fee for doing the job, plus generally reimbursed if there is any type of purchase, for example, an oil change. You go to the oil change shop, you get your oil change, you pay for it, and then you come back and you fill out a questionnaire about your experience, customer service, all of that information. And then you'll get paid, say, $40 for doing that. Plus you'll get reimbursed for the entirety of your oil change. Which means you got a free oil change plus $40 for something you already had to do. A lot of these are food based. So if you are somebody who is struggling to pay for food or you like to eat out, but you really can't afford it, this is a great opportunity. To get some free food. Now what is D Scout? D Scout is a focus group. Now, a lot of people get these confused with surveys. They're not surveys. You are not filling out a whole big questionnaire for 20 cents. These are large paying actual studies. That, for example, one that I did was a 30 minute zoom interview on a laundry detergent. What I thought of the packaging, what I thought of the product, what I thought of their slogans. I got paid $75 for a 30 minute zoom call. Now on this app, you can just fill out your demographic information and then you can start to apply. Mystery shops you can self accept and those happen generally within 24 hours. Whereas research studies, it can take a couple weeks to find out if you've been approved. And these are more hit or miss. But if I snag one or two a month, I'm making anywhere from 50 to 150 dollars for maybe an hour and a half of my time, which is still a win in my book. Comment below your favorite side hustle app. Let me know if you've tried any of these or if there's any ones that I'm missing.
